title: AI-assisted source spot checks for PageLedger 0.5.1
method: Short source-image checks, with mismatches checked against the actual image and selected output. Kharkov and census each received a new direct comparison of all 20 pages after initial source-note defects were found.
limits: AI-assisted observations may still be wrong. No page is certified correct.
Checks cover short readings and visible layout, not complete page transcription.
Corrective comparisons are nonblind. Example selection favors observed errors and cannot estimate accuracy or false-negative rates.
Initial phrase-match counts are excluded because source notes contained capitalization, omitted-marker, and wrong-page errors.
Selected warnings belong to the selected attempt; review reasons may include earlier attempts.
No human review receipt was applied to any real source page.
Full source scans, rendered images, and local transcripts are not distributed with this summary.
